name: rocket-launcher-mcp
description: Rocket Launcher MCP server: connect an app once, decide, and get store materials through launch. Free, no API keys.

scripts.test: node test/run.mjs && node test/lessons.mjs && node test/learning.mjs && node test/shared.mjs && node test/stage.mjs && node test/release.mjs && node ../workers/lessons/test/worker.test.mjs
scripts.bundle: esbuild server.mjs --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --external:@napi-rs/canvas --banner:js="import { createRequire as __cr } from 'node:module'; const require = __cr(import.meta.url);" --outfile=dist/rocket-launcher-mcp.mjs

author: Prezentree
